arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were due to an ingress idle timeout of 30 seconds. Cron drift was caused by a UTC vs local time issue. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database is growing, with 1388 failed jobs and 47 malformed rows. The pg_dump export has been initiated.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Investigate the root causes of the failed jobs, resolve the issues, and resume the failed jobs. Then, review the failed_jobs table for further insights and ensure the cron jobs are correctly scheduled.
